Transcription with verbose JSON response format including timestamp segments

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using LiterLlm;

var apiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("API_KEY") ??
  throw new InvalidOperationException("API_KEY must be set");
using var client = LiterLlmConverter.CreateClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null);
var result = await client.TranscribeAsync(new CreateTranscriptionRequest { File = "audio.mp3", Model = "whisper-1", ResponseFormat = "verbose_json" });
Console.WriteLine(result.Text);
Console.WriteLine(result.Segments);
Console.WriteLine(result.Segments![0].Id);
```
